open_jobs.job_description:
Looking for a Junior DevOps Engineer with a Computer Science background to help automate and streamline our infrastructure. Great opportunity to learn cloud technologies and modern DevOps practices!

Responsibilities:
- Assist in managing AWS cloud infrastructure
- Help build and maintain CI/CD pipelines
- Monitor system performance and reliability
- Automate deployment processes
- Troubleshoot infrastructure issues
- Write infrastructure as code using Terraform
- Collaborate with development teams
- Participate in on-call rotation (with senior support)
- Document processes and procedures

Requirements:
- BS in Computer Science or related technical field
- Basic understanding of Linux/Unix systems
- Familiarity with scripting (Python, Bash, or similar)
- Interest in cloud technologies and automation
- Basic networking knowledge
- Problem-solving mindset
- Good communication skills
- Eagerness to learn new technologies
